(Translated by Google)
I drive a lot on highways and in the city, and I always stop at YPF gas stations. I stopped for lunch, really looking forward to a burger combo, but it wasn't what I expected: burnt fries, half an empty wine bottle, very little lettuce, etc. Maybe it was unintentional, but YPF let me down today.
